does: Enters the client's Menu state: creates an entity with eoc::gamestate::MainMenuComponent, sets EocClient+0xf1 and calls the app's virtual +0x148 (macOS BaseApp +0x150). The UI then gets the game event GE.OnStateMainMenu: Keyboard.xaml's GameRoot sets the substate Eula, whose page raises OpenSplashScreen on Loaded when ShowFirstTimeSetup is false, and the UI state SplashScreen (the press-any-key page) is pushed.

evidence.says: slot 3 (+0x18) of the Menu virtual table bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x55F9918 (state id 7, the object code:ecl::EocClient::Load queues last); same body as macOS ecl::GameStateMenu::Enter bg3_macos_x64+0x357F2E0 (EoCClient.dll exports ecl::GameStateMenu::Enter at slot 3); Mods/MainUI/GUI/StateMachines/Keyboard.xaml and Pages/Eula.xaml read from the game's data
after the client state Menu in every start and after a return from a session to the main menu, GK.Gui.Stuck() names the SplashScreen widget
